remarks: Welcome to this recently built Johnson & Sons custom-designed Townhome, ideally located just steps from Gates Circle. Offering 3,352 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this contemporary and sun-filled residence features an open floor plan, 4 bedrooms, 4 full baths, 10-foot ceilings, large Andersen windows, and beautiful natural wood floors. The first floor offers a seamless living room/dining room combination, private den, and full bath with walk-in shower. The open kitchen is designed for both everyday living and entertaining, featuring Stylestone countertops, tile backsplash, custom Homecrest cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a large island with bar seating. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features hardwood floors, a walk-in closet, and luxurious en-suite bath. Two additional generously sized bedrooms, a full bath, and convenient second-floor laundry complete the level. The finished basement provides valuable additional living space, including a large tiled family room, fourth bedroom with legal egress, and full bath with recessed lighting and tile floor. Additional highlights include a full walk-up attic, central A/C, attached 2-car garage with shared concrete driveway, 150-amp electric service, and durable 50-year architectural shingle roof. A rare opportunity to enjoy modern custom construction, exceptional space, and a prime location in one of Buffalo's most desirable neighborhoods. Also listed as B1722105.
